title: Get game history out of git and into a proper datastore
description:
The 298 game exports in website/public/games/ account for 1.3 GB of the repo. This bloats every clone and checkout — the golden CI job spends ~3 minutes just on checkout because of it. Sparse checkout is a workaround but the real fix is storing game exports in an external datastore (R2, S3, SQLite artifact store, etc.) and pulling them at build time or serving them directly.

Considerations:
- The website build needs game files to generate the leaderboard and game viewer pages
- Blunder analysis reads exports to generate prompts
- Game exports are append-mostly (new games added, occasionally re-exported with annotations)
- The leaderboard generator and game viewer could fetch from a remote store instead of local files
- Git history of game files is not useful — they're machine-generated JSON
